text:
Lina Gomez: hello! first day question \u2014 I followed the console quickstart but after SSO I hit a blank page and the network tab shows 403 on /api/flags.
Lina Gomez: curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags returns {\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"message\":\"missing_console_role\"}. do new hires need a service account?
Riley (Infra): welcome Lina! :wave: no SA for interactive use. new hires get a console-read JIT first. drop your SSO email and Ill create the access request.
Lina Gomez: lina.gomez@redwood.ai
Onboarding Bot: Access request created: ONB-9219 by Riley (Infra). Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/ONB-9219
Riley (Infra): approved the JIT. try reloading and if still 403 run:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags 2>&1 | grep x-request-id
```
Lina Gomez: got x-request-id: rq_9d8e2f, still 403 for prod flags (staging ok).
Kara (Security): hi @Lina prod has an IP allowlist for some admin endpoints. if the JIT grant works but specific api calls 403, include your public IP in the ticket and we'll add a short-lived allowlist.
Mika (DevEx): if you need to toggle flags for your intro demo i can create a temp role with flags:write for 30 minutes  DM me the flag keys.
Riley (Infra): temporary workaround: ssh tunnel via bastion ->
```
ssh -NL 8000:console.internal:443 riley@bastion
# open https://localhost:8000 and re-login
```
Lina Gomez: tunnel worked, can see prod flags now. thanks all! closing the loop once i request a short-lived SA for a demo job.
Kara (Security): note: if you request a service account include justification and expiry (30/90 days preferred). read-only SAs with 90-day expiry are auto-approved.
Lina Gomez: noted, filing follow-up. :smile:
